page_title: MON 2-1 FIO | Monza v Fiorentina 13/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+3' That's the end of the game for Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro, who is replaced by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
90+3' Substitution. Mattia Valoti (Monza) replaces Alessandro Bianco.
90+1' Salvatore Bocchetti prepares a substitution. Daniel Maldini is replaced by Andrea Petagna (Monza).
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Fiorentina for a penalty. Play continues.
87' The referee can't ignore those comments and Warren Bondo (Monza) sees a yellow card for bad language.
87' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
87' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
85' Milan Djuric (Monza) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the David de Gea to make a comfortable save.
84' Total attempts – 9:10.
84' Warren Bondo (Monza) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
83' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
82' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
81' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
80' Daniel Maldini (Monza) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar.
79' The foul by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) was seen by Federico Dionisi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
79' Kevin Martins (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but David de Gea punches the ball away.
78' The referee signals a corner kick to Monza.
78' Pedro Pereira (Monza) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
76' Pedro Pereira (Monza) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball.
74' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) replacing Riccardo Sottil.
74' 2 - 1 Goal! Stefano Turati gets a hand on the penalty from Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
73' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
72' The referee blows his whistle as Andrea Carboni (Monza) was too aggressive in his challenge. Fiorentina are awarded a penalty kick!
72' The ball possession is 38:62.
71' Milan Djuric (Monza) is penalised for a foul. Federico Dionisi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
68' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Robin Gosens.
68' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) replaces Andrea Colpani.
66' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
65' A cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
64' A substitution has been made. Amir Richardson is replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina).
63' 2 - 0 Goal! Pedro Pereira puts a cross into the box and finds Daniel Maldini (Monza), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
61' Stefano Turati (Monza) gets a yellow card.
60' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
59' Daniel Maldini (Monza) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
58' The referee signals a substitution. Milan Djuric (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Gianluca Caprari.
58' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
56' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Stefano Turati comes off his line to gather the ball.

54' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
54' Half-chance! Dodo (Fiorentina) plays a pass into the box, but Stefano Turati reacts well to snuff out the attack.
53' Dodo (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
53' Fiorentina take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
52' Fiorentina are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
51' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) trips an opposition player and Federico Dionisi signals a foul.

48' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
48' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Salvatore Bocchetti makes a half-time substitution. Kevin Martins comes on in place of Pablo Mari (Monza).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Albert Gudmundsson comes off for Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The opposition can't get near Daniel Maldini (Monza), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

44' 1 - 0 Goal! Patrick Ciurria (Monza) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. David de Gea is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
43' The resulting corner, taken by Gianluca Caprari (Monza), comes to nothing.
42' The ball is cleared after Gianluca Caprari (Monza) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:0.
40' Federico Dionisi blows his whistle as Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
39' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is flagged for offside.
38' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
36' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
33' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
32' Monza are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
32' Dodo (Fiorentina) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
31' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Monza.
29' The Monza players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
25' Warren Bondo (Monza) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
24' Armando Izzo (Monza) tackles a bit over-zealously and Federico Dionisi blows for a foul. The referee signals a free kick. Fiorentina are going to take it from long range.
23' Daniel Maldini (Monza) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
22' Fiorentina failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
19' The Fiorentina players are stunned as referee Federico Dionisi changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
18' Celebrations by Fiorentina are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
17' The referee gives a yellow card to Pablo Mari (Monza).

17' Pablo Mari (Monza) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty to Fiorentina! Let's see who's going to take it.
14' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
14' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
12' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies well wide of the right post.
12' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza).
10' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico Dionisi who sees an offensive foul.
8' Dodo (Fiorentina) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
8' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
7' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
7' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
6' The ball rebounds to Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
5' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is about to take a corner kick.
5' Dodo (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
4' A player from Fiorentina commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
3' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Federico Dionisi.
